name: void fishing [QUESTS]
desc:
this abyss is ripe with loot, son.
every time a game is closed, or a world is ended, or an object goes just a little too fast, it might end up here - in the void, waiting to be salvaged.

join the group for autofish!
https://www.roblox.com/groups/8019744/wunmo#!/about

🌌 FEATURES 
catch loot — every cast is a catch!
set sail - find islands in an infinite void world!
open troves — the voidfishers of the past loved to keep their treasures in troves, that now float and wait to be caught.
complete quests — some customers put in special orders. get great rewards for completing them!
catalog the void — over 230 different items to collect and log
uncover the secrets — what hides in the abyss?
